ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (29) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Орудие» (orudie, 'tool') is kept as 'tool', «ум» (um) as 'mind', and «наука» (nauka) as 'science'; the italic *I* in the Brahmanic saying is «я» (ya, 'I'), and Lichtenberg's italic *learned man* is «ученый» (uchyony). «Бабочки» (babochki, 'butterflies, moths') flying to candles are 'moths'; attributions follow the print («Браминская мудрость», Braminskaya mudrost', 'Brahmanic wisdom'; «Гулистан» Саади, 'The “Gulistan” of Saadi').
